summary: Authored scenario rosters list each agent's terminal runtime in runtime_ids, terminal first as the gateway does, so replay clients can reach a scenario's terminal

replay.detail: Scenario fixtures and their generator only; no daemon replay or rebuild.

schema.detail: No storage or schema changes. The roster fixtures gain runtime ids in the existing runtime_ids field.

compatibility.detail: runtime_ids is an existing roster field; clients that read only the agent runtime are unaffected. Recorded and caller-supplied rosters and fixture ids are unchanged. 25 authored roster.json fixtures are regenerated.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the agent-only runtime_ids in the authored rosters.
